ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixels (~70%) with high-intensity (white) linear and mottled regions (~30%) distributed primarily across the upper and middle sections of both lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white patches are concentrated along the upper margins of the left and right lobes; extensive white linear streaks (rake marks) are scattered throughout the central black regions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a pixel angle of approximately 35-40 degrees and high vertical depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular serrated boundary with frequent peaks and valleys; notable deep indentations present on the inner margins of both lobes near the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature on the upper edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp, slightly upward-turned distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast, textured clusters of beige/white pixel blobs (barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of white, non-parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) covering a significant portion of the black ventral surface, particularly dense on the upper half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent barnacle encrustations at the lobe tips; extensive vertical and diagonal rake marks across both lobes indicating significant physical interaction or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible brownish bio-fouling or sediment accumulation on the barnacle clusters at the lobe tips.
